syllabus.title: Weekly Test 09 Syllabus
syllabus.content:
1. Physics :-



Electrostatics and Current Electricity, Moving Charges and Magnetism, Magnetism and Matter, Electromagnetic Induction, Alternating Current, Electromagnetic Waves, Ray Optics and Optical Instruments, Kinematics, NLM, Motion in a Plane, Laws of Motion, Work, Energy and Power


2. Chemistry :-


Solutions, Electrochemistry, Chemical Kinetics, Haloalkanes and Haloarenes (Optical Isomerism & Hydrocarbon), Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers, Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids, Biomolecules, Mole concept, Volumetric Analysis, Atomic Structure, Chemical equilibrium



3. Mathematics :-



Determinants, Matrices, Relations and Functions, Inverse Trigonometric Functions, Limit Continuity and Differentiability, Method of Differentiation, Application of Derivatives, Indefinite Integration, Definite Integration, Application of integrals, Differential Equation.

• ➢    Amines, Biomolecules till Carbohydrate (Part-2).
• ENGLISH-
• ➢  The Tiger King, Journey to the end of the Earth.

📌 MATHEMATICS
• ➢  Differential Equations, Vector.

📌 BIOLOGY
• ➢  Molecular Basis of Inheritance.

syllabus.title: Practice Test - 05 : PCMBE Syllabus
syllabus.content:
📌 PHYSICS
• ➢    Electromagnetic Waves, Ray Optics and Optical Instruments till Concept of rays; Laws of reflection; Plane mirrors; (reflection from plane surface); Image formation and characteristics of image; Speed of image of moving object.

📌 CHEMISTRY
• ➢    Biomolecules, Organic chemistry, Solutions till Osmosis and osmotic pressure , reverse osmosis.
• ENGLISH-
• ➢  The Rattrap, Indigo.

📌 MATHEMATICS
• ➢  Three Dimensional Geometry, Linear Programming.

📌 BIOLOGY
• ➢  Evolution, Human Health and Disease till Innate and Acquired Immunity, Active and Passive Immunity.

syllabus.title: Practice Test - 07 : PCMBE Syllabus
syllabus.content:
📌 PHYSICS
• ➢    Wave Optics, Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter, Atoms.

📌 CHEMISTRY
• ➢    Electrochemistry, Chemical Kinetics.
• ENGLISH-
• ➢  A Road Side Stand, Aunt Jennifer’s Tigers, Poets And Pancakes, The Enemy, The Interview-Part I And Part II, Going Place. On the Face of it, Grammar Section, Memories of childhood.

📌 MATHEMATICS
• ➢  Determinants, Matrices, Inverse Trigonometric Functions+Probability.

📌 BIOLOGY
• ➢  Biotechnology: principles and process, Biotechnolgy and its Application.
